subject: Private VPC: next steps and allowlist details (NetWave Finance)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Amir Patel <amir.patel@netwave.com>, Julia Nguyen <julia.nguyen@netwave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:07:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC: follow-up & allowlist questions (NetWave)

Hi Amir / Julia — great to meet today. Quick post-call recap and the minimal info we need from NetWave to scope a Private VPC deployment and confirm timelines: 

1) Deployment preference: you indicated Private VPC with PrivateLink as preferred — can you confirm PrivateLink is a hard requirement vs VPC peering as a fallback?

2) Egress & allowlist: we need the outbound IPs your NetOps team will allow for inbound callbacks (our egress range if you choose PrivateLink is typically a small set; for peering we only need the peered CIDR). Please provide an initial allowlist or confirm you want us to share hostnames instead.

3) Tenant/cidr: confirm the CIDR block for the NetWave subnet that will host the PrivateLink endpoint or peering allocation. If you don’t have one yet, your NetOps can give us preferred /24s.

4) KMS & compliance: Julia — you mentioned a SOC2 requirement and KMS integration. Please attach the security questionnaire and any KMS/HSM contact details.

5) Timeline & procurement: Amir — you mentioned procurement aims for late July. Please confirm the PO lead time so we can align Reserved Dedicated vs Private rollout. If procurement needs an SOW/pricing sheet we’ll attach one.

Next steps from Redwood: Ben will set up a 60-minute network workshop with your NetOps to walk through PrivateLink handshake, port list, and certificates. I’ll follow up with a short pre-work checklist you can send to ops.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Phone: +1 (415) 555-0193
From: Amir Patel <amir.patel@netwave.com>

Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC: follow-up & allowlist questions (NetWave)

Thanks Tessa — appreciated the recap. A few quick answers from NetWave Ops: 

- PrivateLink is preferred for security reasons (we can do peering if there are blockers). Marked as preferred (not strictly mandatory, but close).
- Egress/allowlist: Julian will provide our firewall/contact list. Expect a first pass of allowed inbound IPs from your side; otherwise we can allowdns-based hostnames.
- CIDR: We can allocate 10.12.200.0/24 for the PrivateLink endpoint.
- KMS: we use AWS KMS; Julia will attach the relevant sections of our compliance pack.
- Timeline: Procurement aiming to issue a PO by 2026-07-22 if pricing and SOW look good. We may need a short SOW for Private VPC deployment and an estimated committed start date.

I’ll ask Julian to join the workshop. Attaching the security questionnaire and a simple network diagram (draft) — see attachments.

Best,
Amir

Tessa / Jordan — thanks for the thread. Proposed internal plan: 

- I’ll draft a one-page SOW for a Private VPC engagement (network setup, endpoint handoff, validation window) and include Optional: Dedicated reserved capacity pricing if they want predictable throughput during migration.
- Schedule network workshop: propose two slots next week (Wed 07/08 10:00-11:00 PT or Thu 07/09 14:00-15:00 PT). Jordan — can you host the Zoom and invite our infra engineer?
- Technical pre-work checklist (I’ll attach): required CIDR, certs, allowed ports (443 + 8443 for control plane), and an ops contact (Julian) who can approve firewall changes.

We should also prepare an example allowlist file (CSV) and a brief diagram showing PrivateLink flow vs peering for their security team. Vanessa — can you prep the pricing sheet and be ready to include Dedicated vs Hosted delta?

Ben
